row.title: Kernel 9.0.0 pinned and mapped; 8.2.1 stays active until its conflict rows close
row.body: The owner's Kernel 9.0.0 text is stored verbatim in doctrine/kernel-9.0.0.md, pinned by sha256 in kernel/kernel.lock, and mapped clause by clause in doctrine/kernel-9.json (9 built, 12 partial, 5 gaps, 3 conflicts). Three clauses conflict with what is active: E1 (EV changes by a human-identity review vs CLOSED-LOOP-AXIOM), F4 and S4 (8.2.1 IC-YES-001 and same-output EVOLUTION). Cutover is blocked by code: kernel9 --check fails if active is set while a conflict row remains. kernel --check runs kernel9 --check, so CI carries it with no workflow change.
